reduction_justification: A five-set is a clique exactly when all distinct circular-distance variables occurring among its ten pairs are true, and is independent exactly when they are all false. Duplicate five-sets with the same distance signature therefore induce identical positive/negative clauses and may be deduplicated without changing satisfiability.
variable_semantics: variable d is true iff every unordered vertex pair at circular distance d in Z_43 is a graph edge
